title: Vaerion durable human gate record (v1)
description: A gate is a pause point that SURVIVES process death (ADR-0004; constitution P4 / invariant 9: humans are the only approval authority). Open and resolution are journal records; resolution is idempotent — a second resolution is refused with E1303 and the first resolution stays authoritative. The answer payload is journaled redacted.

gate_id.description: ULID of the gate; referenced by prompt decisions.

decision_id.description: The prompt decision that opened this gate (journal link; present for broker-opened gates).

state.description: open: awaiting human authority. resolved: a human answered (requires resolved_at and answer). cancelled: withdrawn before resolution.

question.description: What the human is being asked.

options.description: Structured answer options; the rendering contract for SDKs and the API.

answer.description: Resolution payload (journaled, redacted). Required when state is resolved.

resolved_by.description: Gates are resolved by human authority only; automation proposes, humans dispose.

resolved_at.description: Resolution timestamp (RFC3339). Required when state is resolved.

then.description: A resolved gate must carry its resolution timestamp and the human's answer.
